type.description: menu button type, refer to `Button` Component, only works when `split-button` is true
type.description_zh: 菜单按钮类型，同 Button 组件(只在`split-button`为 true 的情况下有效)

size.description: menu size, also works on the split button
size.description_zh: 菜单尺寸，在 split-button 为 true 的情况下也对触发按钮生效

:button-props.description: props for the button component, refer to Button Attributes
:button-props.description_zh: 按钮组件的属性，参考 Button 组件

split-button.description: whether a button group is displayed
split-button.description_zh: 下拉触发元素呈现为按钮组

:trigger-keys.description: specify which keys on the keyboard can trigger when pressed
:trigger-keys.description_zh: 指定哪些按键可以触发下拉菜单

hide-on-click.description: whether to hide menu after clicking menu-item
hide-on-click.description_zh: 是否在点击菜单项后隐藏菜单

:show-timeout.description: delay time before show a dropdown (only works when trigger is `hover`)
:show-timeout.description_zh: 展开下拉菜单的延时（仅在 trigger 为 hover 时有效）

:hide-timeout.description: delay time before hide a dropdown (only works when trigger is `hover`)
:hide-timeout.description_zh: 收起下拉菜单的延时（仅在 trigger 为 hover 时有效）

role.description: the ARIA role attribute for the dropdown menu. Depending on the use case, you may want to change this to 'navigation'
role.description_zh: 下拉菜单的 ARIA 属性。 根据具体场景，您可能想要将此更改为'navigation'

popper-class.description: custom class name for Dropdown's dropdown

teleported.description: whether the dropdown popup is teleported to the body
teleported.description_zh: 是否将下拉列表插入至 body 元素

persistent.description: when dropdown inactive and `persistent` is `false` , dropdown menu will be destroyed
persistent.description_zh: 当下拉菜单未激活并且 `persistent` 为 `false` 时，下拉菜单将被销毁

events.name: click
events.description: if `split-button` is `true`, triggers when left button is clicked
events.description_zh: `split-button` 为 true 时，点击左侧按钮的回调

events.name: command
events.description: triggers when a dropdown item is clicked, the parameters is the command dispatched from the dropdown item
events.description_zh: 点击菜单项触发的事件回调

events.name: visible-change
events.description: triggers when the dropdown appears/disappears, the param is true when it appears, and false otherwise
events.description_zh: 下拉框出现/隐藏时触发

slots.name: default
slots.description: content of Dropdown. Notice: Must be a valid html dom element (ex. `<span>, <button> etc.`) or `el-component`, to attach the trigger listener
slots.description_zh: 下拉菜单的内容。 注意：必须是有效的html dom元素（例如 `<span>, <button> 等`）或 `el-component`，以附加触发监听器

slots.name: dropdown
slots.description: content of the Dropdown Menu, usually a `<el-dropdown-menu>` element
slots.description_zh: 下拉列表，通常是 <el-dropdown-menu> 组件
